shortlist.title: B16 uncertainty sensitivity to ticket versus flat-to-flat episode sampling
shortlist.family: B16 KangarooGrid; inference diagnostic, not a new family or EA child
shortlist.novelty_status: EXTEND_PRIOR_EVIDENCE — concentration counts exist, but no matched sampling-unit sensitivity result located
shortlist.mechanism: Multiple closed tickets within one inventory episode can share the same adverse path. Treating them as independent resampling units may understate uncertainty. Compare sampling units while keeping the economic ledger and estimator fixed.

source_evidence.claim: Non-normal and serially dependent source returns motivate resampling-aware inference.
source_evidence.transfer_limit: The source is Irish equities, not validation of any B16 bootstrap.

source_evidence.claim: Selection history matters and non-normal returns constrain standard statistics.
source_evidence.transfer_limit: No paper threshold, p-value gate or Grade is imported.

source_evidence.claim: Exact frozen-parent ledger exists; Monte Carlo remains NOT RUN.
B16 tickets and flat-to-flat cycles need not represent interchangeable participation units.
source_evidence.transfer_limit: Its older proxy counts are not reused as exact R4 parent counts.

negative_evidence_checked.result: Do not reopen exit-off concentration or closed RSI/depth paths.
KINT-001 unresolved; episode counts cannot ratify a sample floor.

shortlist.one_logical_change: Change the resampling unit from individual realized ticket cashflow to intact, chronologically reconstructed flat-to-flat episode cashflow. Keep the full-window total-net statistic, original economic ledger, window, number of bootstrap replications and interval definition fixed.
shortlist.parent_reference: The same accepted lane1 R4 USDJPY/H1 BUY 14/30 reference and exact set/EX5 as rank 1. Each of the four reports is analyzed separately; no pooled cross-model or cross-install sample.
shortlist.home_proposal: USDJPY/H1 BUY, MT5-lane1 / D:\Meta 5; exact R4 MAIN/BWD report pairs.
shortlist.main_test_shape: Proposed offline design: for each MAIN model report, N-ticket IID bootstrap resamples N tickets versus K-episode IID bootstrap resamples K whole episodes. Compare distributions of total realized net and central 95% interval widths; propose 5,000 replications with deterministic seed 20260912 for both arms, frozen before the new calculation. These are diagnostic method choices, not universal acceptance bars. Retain observed totals, N/K, episode sizes and yearly concentration.
shortlist.bwd_role: Repeat the identical method on each frozen BWD ledger. Use neither BWD nor 2020 to choose grouping, interval, seed or repetition count. Both historical windows are known evidence.
shortlist.falsifier: The proposed direction ('ticket sampling understates uncertainty') is not supported unless episode-sampled interval width exceeds ticket-sampled width in both windows within each model; mixed/equal/narrower outcomes close as MIXED_OR_NOT_SUPPORTED, without selecting a favorable model. Unstable estimates or invalid grouping are UNKNOWN/BLOCKED, never a strategy verdict.
shortlist.participation_risk: K may be much smaller than N, episodes may span years, and adjacent episodes may still be serially dependent. IID episodes preserve within-episode grouping only; they do not establish full independence. Report intervals descriptively, not calibrated ruin probabilities, formal significance, effective sample floors or native equity DD.
shortlist.mechanical_dependencies: Validate volume-conserving flat/nonflat transitions, final-flat state and complete cashflows from immutable reports. Existing parser consumes FIFO volume to detect flat boundaries; it does not prove actual ticket-to-position identity. Include same-time deal ordering, partial-close, entry-charge and end-open refusal fixtures in a later tooling contract.
shortlist.data_requirements: Reuse the same four hash-bound reports/INIs/receipts as rank 1. No additional market data needed. Native mark-to-market equity path is absent; therefore no margin, equity-DD, ruin or stateful price-path replay claims.
shortlist.template_readiness: EXISTING_TEMPLATE_REFERENCE / OFFLINE_ONLY. No EA source change; a bounded diagnostic script may be needed in a later contract. No live sizing decision.

estimated_tester_cells.budget_note: Shared read-only receipt intake with rank 1 is possible later; statistical output remains distinct.

shortlist.downstream_skip: Avoid treating hundreds of tickets as independently qualified observations and avoid an invalid ticket-shuffle ruin exercise. No new tester cells are needed to compare these two accounting samples.
shortlist.stop_rule: Freeze one sampling-unit comparison and stop after four reports. Do not optimize bootstrap blocks, search p-values, change KINT, retune the EA or claim that this is a complete Monte Carlo robustness pass.
